title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-2u0i: multi_fragment_single_window uses arbitrary rule_id=20 and nonsensical receiver_limit=7
description:
The test at `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs:60` passes `FragmentSender::new(&payload, 20, 7)` where `rule_id=20` is inconsistent with all other tests in the file (which use `RULE_ID_A_TO_B = 0`) and `receiver_limit=7` makes no semantic sense for a 128-byte payload — the receiver can't reassemble 128 bytes in a 7-byte buffer. Other tests correctly use `DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT` or `packet.len()`.

Fix: Change to `FragmentSender::new(&payload, RULE_ID_A_TO_B, DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT)` to match the rest of the test file.
